The applicant/accused is also convicted for the offence u/ s 7(v) r/w Rules 62 and 32(e) and (f) punishable under section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to suffer S.I.
for six months and payment of fine of Rs.1,000/- and in default, to suffer S.I. for one month.
3.
The learned Counsel for the applicant/accused submits that by this revision application, he has prayed for suspension of the said conviction and sentence and also for bail.
He submits that the applicant/accused was on bail throughout the trial and appeal period.
He is taken in custody on 22.10.2018 and hence, he has moved this Court for bail.

The learned Counsel submits that if the applicant/accused is released on bail, he will not commit any such offence muchless under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and will abide by all the terms that the Court may impose, if the bail is granted.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The applicant has submitted that this revision is preferred
 against the judgment and order dated 22.10.2018 passed by the
 learned Additional Sessions Judge, Solapur in Criminal Appeal
 No.20 of 2018 thereby concurring with the judgment dated
 8.2.2018 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Solapur
 in R.C.C. No.345 of 2011.
suffer simple imprisonment for six months and to pay fine of Rs.1,000/-, and in default to suffer S.I. for one month.
He is taken in custody on 22.10.2018 and hence, he has moved this Court for bail.
The learned Counsel submits that if the applicant/accused is released on bail, he will not commit any such offence muchless under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and will abide by all the terms that the Court may impose, if the bail is granted.
In view thereof, the following order is passed:
 ORDER i) The impugned conviction and sentence dated 8.2.2018 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Solapur in RCC No.345 of 2011, is suspended pending revision;
ii) The applicant/accused shall be released on bail upon furnishing bail bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount;
iii) The applicant/accused shall not indulge into any criminal activity including under the Food Adulteration Act.
iv) The applicant/accused shall attend all the dates of hearing of Revision.
